kcc_query_text_example: Retired non-MTS state board employee with 2.0 acres rainfed sunflower in Manvi taluk, Raichur; receiving exactly ₹10,000 per month pension; registered on FRUITS portal but PM-KISAN 17th installment rejected at state nodal verification; need reason for rejection and grievance procedure.

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: RTC registered pre-February 2019 in Manvi taluk

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: NSS 77th Round: Marginal dryland sunflower cultivators in Raichur with mixed non-farm retirement income sources.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: FRUITS & PM-KISAN grievance portal tickets: Retired institutional pensioners querying why Rs. 2,000 direct benefit transfers were withheld under the Rs. 10,000 pension cutoff rule.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Benchmark Challenge 3 (Disqualification Boundary): Exactly ₹10,000/month pension test. Evaluates whether the inclusive statutory cutoff (>= ₹10,000) correctly triggers INELIGIBLE (rule key PMKISAN_PENSION_OVER_10K_EXCLUSION) for a non-MTS pensioner despite holding 2.0 acres of registered land; tests General Merit corporation exclusion under Ganga Kalyana.

intended_test_purpose: Evaluate PM-KISAN pension exclusion boundary at exactly ₹10,000/month; verify explicit non-MTS exemption status representation; confirm disqualification with rule key PMKISAN_PENSION_OVER_10K_EXCLUSION.
unresolved_dependencies: Treasury pension sanction order documentation validating non-MTS cadre status
PM-KISAN state-level grievance adjudication circular on exact ₹10,000 gross vs net pension determination
